scope.discovery: Current homepage/navigation links, plus linked asset naming and non-naval water pages.
scope.retrieval: Direct HTTPS GET of official HTML; SHA-256 of UTF-8 response content.

provenance.role: Prior REA findings and owner-approved file-adapter acceptance boundaries.
Prior pinned source/public-API audit; includes source inspection ranges and historical local evidence.
Prior shipped sprite-library static trace and unresolved native font CLI.
Pinned reusable SDK candidate; prior source audit, not new execution.
Pinned editor-extension examples; not proof of full editor persistence.
Root-owned local artifact identity snapshot. Exact file identity only; documentation and runtime compatibility unknown.
Retained managed member declarations/CIL; candidates matched to manifest artifact.
Retained native registration and Qt wiring; no handler invocation.

interpretation.intended_modes: Target contexts for implementation, not modes in which a route has been observed to work.
interpretation.unverified: Documentation describes an action, but no operation-specific callable route is established here.
interpretation.declared: A command/callback/member is documented or declared. Invocation, thread/lifetime and output remain unverified.
interpretation.traced: Prior source/CIL inspection follows a relevant implementation path. This is not an engine acceptance result.
interpretation.coverage_accepted: Always false in this inventory. No new execution, independent output validation or cold reload was performed.
interpretation.evidence_refs: path identifies a repository file; optional finding_operation selects operation_findings[].operation in the prior JSON audit. These are not URL anchors.
interpretation.operation_granularity: Actions supported by page text; related parameter settings and scene recipes may be grouped. No generic create/read/update/delete Cartesian expansion.
interpretation.source_origin: Official documented operations and two explicitly derived validation requirements are separately marked.
interpretation.historical_run30840: Retained local proof concerns one original animation clip only. It does not raise any current inventory operation to verified status.
interpretation.copyright_scope: Short operational paraphrases and URLs only; full fetched source text is not committed.
interpretation.build_binding: Pins the intended local target manifest. It does not assert current documentation describes that build or that any candidate runs.
interpretation.installed_candidates: Separate retained-audit operation/route candidates. Some correlate with documented actions and must not be counted twice. Registration/UI wiring and empty callbacks do not establish callable authoring APIs.

mode_vocabulary.offline-authoring: Local file authoring without an active editor session.
mode_vocabulary.client-runtime: Shipping game/client runtime; replaces earlier shipping-game alias.
mode_vocabulary.external-authoring: External authoring toolchain such as FMOD.
mode_vocabulary.external-service: Network publication/service operation; separate authorization required.

file_adapter_conditions: Cold reload in the intended consumer/build.
Check dirty editor state and avoid silently overwriting it.
Handle partial writes and provide recovery.
runtime_conditions: Demonstrate cleanup and failed/cancelled operation behavior.
exclusions: UI-only interaction does not count as API coverage.
Unavailable/no-effect responses do not satisfy required capabilities.
Offline files do not save an active dirty scene or join its undo stack.
Runtime transforms/material setters do not establish persistent authoring.
acceptance_policy.next_reconciliation: Root-owned build identities, command/binding inventory and MMR-392/393/394 probes must join these records before MMR-395 acceptance.

gaps.description: Installed menus, command registrations, bindings and mode/build variants are not reconciled with this documentation inventory.
Grouped scene recipes and the long ship guide have not been expanded into every script parameter or holder. Images, embedded videos and linked external tutorials were not inspected.
Active dirty-scene save, save-as, reload, crash recovery and global undo/redo require exact native or managed routes; offline scene writers do not substitute.
Terrain brush falloff, every node/layer option, edit-data preservation, foliage deletion and stochastic painting need installed reconciliation and file round trips.
Complete topology editing, generation algorithms, undo and path tangent semantics are unresolved; public queries are not authoring proof.
No dedicated road/river generation workflow found in the fetched current TOC. Paths, barriers, water and flowmap are distinct operations.
Asset deletion, dependency graph, source reimport, import cancellation, resource database repair and every registered importer require installed inventory.
LOD generation/editing, format matrix, complete collision cooking and mesh deformation options exceed documented import subset.
No dedicated morph authoring leaf found in current TOC. Pinned SDK morph writer explicitly lacked engine verification.
No dedicated particle-authoring leaf found. Component attachment and audio references do not establish particle asset CRUD, curves or serialization.
Empty/short Skeletons leaf and resource editor descriptions do not reconcile all ragdoll joints, cloth cooking, reimport and runtime reset paths.
Atmosphere selection, reflection settings and water controls do not expose every weather simulation, capture or viewport screenshot operation.
PRT grid/edit-data workflows are documented; full reflection, terrain, lightmap, shader-cache and other installed bake commands remain unreconciled.
Sprite/font workflows and XML usage do not inventory full Gauntlet widgets, UI inspection, localization translation/pluralization or layout authoring.
Documented batch/settings options remain untraced against native FontAtlas. Sample contains concatenated 0.5-mode text; exact tokenization must be established.
FMOD Studio export scripting, mixer ownership, banks, event schemas and full audible behavior need toolchain/version and output verification; legacy sound page is explicitly outdated.
Module examples are not a complete reproducible build/install/repair contract; proprietary dependency discovery and reinstall sources remain implementation requirements.
Client/editor/server publishing requires exact commands, source inclusion, dependency closure, diagnostics and independent cold-load proof for each target.
Official override and upload pages differ on editability of editor-target output. Reconcile actual package contents; uploader config generation is not upload completion.
Script callbacks and extension examples do not enumerate runtime graphs, event subscription, object lifetime or campaign/mission schema.
Documented mission launch and animation examples do not inventory authoritative combat, AI, physics or campaign controls. Existing REA/runtime evidence must supply candidates.
SyncData example concerns behavior persistence only. General runtime save/load, campaign compatibility, replay and deterministic resumption are undocumented in fetched leaves.
Full sails/oars/boarding/upgrade/ballista and water-simulation contracts remain partially grouped; image-only navigation IDs and base-map APIs need reconciliation.
Server hosting/custom modes are documented, but installed server identity, headless behavior and complete command list remain untested.
Bounded diagnostics, reinstall, documentation, integration and adversarial tests are product requirements, not certified Modding Kit operations.
